svg.aria-label: How the planter tower waters itself. Pots I drew in Tinkercad and printed in black ABS on a Prusa MK3 hang in the pockets of a secondhand wire postcard rack, one above the other. I water the top pot, and holes in the bottom of each pot drip into the pot below, so the water works its way down the whole tower.
svg.text: Holes in each pot drip into the one below.
